system.description: The four Hunter Rituals only, in a discipline flavour of your choice: Arm Up (a community gains +5 damage vs your Forte via a swapped weapon Quality), Freedom (release a controlled or possessed creature; fails if it takes damage during the performance), Smoke Out (Forte creatures in the area must reveal themselves; a Villain may spend an Ultima Point to stay hidden), Land Survey (know the ritual area like the back of your hand). Helpers' IP cuts the MP cost, 10 per point.
